bg.doc: Surfaces that sit above the page: cards, panels, inputs, toolbars.

bg-subtle.doc: Page chrome, table headers, alternating rows — one step behind bg.

bg-muted.doc: Inset wells and disabled fills — one step in front of bg.

border-strong.doc: Control borders and hover borders — the visible edge of an input or a secondary button.

text.doc: Body text and headings. Clears AA on every surface.

text-secondary.doc: Labels, units, meta. Clears AA on bg.

text-tertiary.doc: Placeholders and decorative meta. Deliberately below AA; never load-bearing.

accent.doc: The one hue that brands the product: primary fills, links, the focus ring.

accent-hover.doc: Hover state of an accent fill.

accent-fg.doc: Text, icons and knobs drawn ON an accent fill.

accent-subtle.doc: Tinted chips and selected rows — a wash of the accent that body text still reads on.

success-subtle.doc: Tinted background for a success badge or row.

success-fg.doc: Text and icons drawn ON a solid success fill.

warning.doc: Degraded state, needs attention but not action.

warning-subtle.doc: Tinted background for a warning badge or row.

warning-fg.doc: Text and icons drawn ON a solid warning fill.

danger.doc: Failed state, and the only status hue that may be used as text.

danger-hover.doc: Hover state of a danger fill. Danger is the only status used as a button fill, hence the only status with a hover.

danger-subtle.doc: Tinted background for a danger badge or row.

danger-fg.doc: Text and icons drawn ON a solid danger fill.

info-subtle.doc: Tinted background for an info badge or row.

info-fg.doc: Text and icons drawn ON a solid info fill.

chart-1.doc: Categorical chart series slot 1. Series hues are data and status hues are alarms — a series that reads as a status tells the viewer something the data never said, which is what the ΔE floor in src/lint/voices.test.ts holds apart.

chart-2.doc: Categorical chart series slot 2. Series hues are data and status hues are alarms — a series that reads as a status tells the viewer something the data never said, which is what the ΔE floor in src/lint/voices.test.ts holds apart.

chart-3.doc: Categorical chart series slot 3. Series hues are data and status hues are alarms — a series that reads as a status tells the viewer something the data never said, which is what the ΔE floor in src/lint/voices.test.ts holds apart.

chart-4.doc: Categorical chart series slot 4. Series hues are data and status hues are alarms — a series that reads as a status tells the viewer something the data never said, which is what the ΔE floor in src/lint/voices.test.ts holds apart.

chart-5.doc: Categorical chart series slot 5. Series hues are data and status hues are alarms — a series that reads as a status tells the viewer something the data never said, which is what the ΔE floor in src/lint/voices.test.ts holds apart.

trace-glow.doc: The colour of the ONE glow a voice is allowed, on its signature element only. Optional: a voice with no signature element declares no glow. Derive it from --accent rather than restating a hue, so retuning the accent cannot leave the glow behind.

font-mono.doc: Every reading a machine produced: numerals, counters, eyebrows. Pair it with tabular-nums.

text-xs.doc: Type step xs (12/16 — meta, column headers, hints).

text-xs--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-xs. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

text-sm.doc: Type step sm (14/18 — body base for tool UI).

text-sm--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-sm. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

text-base.doc: Type step base (16/22 — body base for reading surfaces).

text-base--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-base. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

text-lg--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-lg. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

text-xl--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-xl. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

text-2xl--line-height.doc: Line height paired with text-2xl. Tailwind reads the `--name--line-height` suffix as the pair.

container-prose-page.doc: Reading-surface line length; generates max-w-prose-page. Distinct from Tailwind's built-in max-w-prose.

z-raised.doc: A sticky header or a raised row, above the page and nothing else.

z-overlay.doc: Dropdowns, popovers, select menus, and a dialog's scrim.

z-modal.doc: Dialog content, above its own overlay.

z-toast.doc: Toasts and tooltips — the layer that must clear a modal.

motion-fast.doc: State changes the eye should not have to wait for: hover, press, a switch knob.

motion-base.doc: Entrances and exits: a dialog, a popover, a toast.

ease-standard.doc: The one easing curve. Fast out of the gate, settled at the end.
